**STATUS: PASS (static, no BLOCKER found).** Static-only review as instructed; `node --check` on the RUNROOT file passed (exit 0, fixed binary sha `1ef99ea2…` verified). I did not execute the suite, the adapter, or any other node command.

**Item 1 — Imports/exports/injection points: OK**
- Check imports only `createHostedSession, normalizeScreenshotBytes` (`…/checks/test_capture_regression.mjs:9-10`); both are real exports (`scripts/line_backup_cua_adapter.mjs:16`, `:77`).
- Option shape matches: adapter `:77-79` accepts `{app, bridge, retain, classify, sessionId, clock, wait, menuWaitMs}`; check injects app/bridge/retain/classify/clock (in `makeHarness`, `:17-67`) and relies on default `menuWaitMs=1200` (valid, `:82`).
- Adapter-required app methods (6, `:80`) all present in fake app (`check:31-38`); bridge/retain/classify are functions (`:81`).

**Item 2 — Asserted codes/behaviors exist verbatim: OK, zero mismatches**
- `CAPTURE_BYTES_INVALID` adapter `:17,:26,:31`; `CUA_FRAME_REFERENCE_REQUIRED` `:42`; `CAPTURE_INCOMPLETE` `:117`; `CLASSIFIER_FRAME_MISMATCH` `:128`; `FRESH_CAPTURE_REQUIRED` `:91` (inclusive `<= 5000`).
- Behavior claims line up: interval anchored pre-capture and never renewed by retain/classify (`:110-131`, esp. `at:requestStartedAtMonotonic` `:130`; `observe` rejects on bad retain ref via `verifyFrameReference` `:37-43,:125`); openAlbum freshness gates before any bridge call (`:153-156`). Mirrored in frozen suite too (`tests/test_cua_adapter.mjs:68-69,:144`).

**Item 3 — Assertion forms: OK**
`assert.throws(fn, /re/)` (`check:73`), `assert.rejects(promise, /re/)` (`:143-144,182,190,193,200`), `assert.match` only on strings (`:121,123-124,166`). All rejecting targets are async-promise-returning calls; all thrown values are `Error` with message codes.

**Item 4 — Isolation/side effects/collisions: OK**
No fs/child_process/network/process APIs (grep only matched the header comment, `check:3`). Top level is consts + `makeHarness` + 9 `test()` registrations; nothing global is mutated; adapter import touches only descriptor reads (`adapter:9-14`). ESM module scoping rules out name collisions in one process; no state shared between files either way.

**Item 5 — 16 MiB boundary: OK**
Adapter limit is `byteLength <= 16 * 1024 * 1024` (`adapter:29`); exactly 16 MiB accepted and >16 MiB rejected. Check uses 16 MiB+1 rejection (`check:71`) and exact-16-MiB acceptance incl. `buffer.byteLength` exactness (`check:75-78`), which holds because the copy is `new Uint8Array(byteLength)` (`adapter:32`).

**BLOCKERS:** none.

**RISKS / unverified assumptions**
- Static inference only — runtime PASS not executed (forbidden); exotic-receiver getter behavior (`adapter:9-14` on DataView/Uint16Array/Float64Array paths) is reasoned, not observed; both failure modes still surface `CAPTURE_BYTES_INVALID` as asserted.
- Import path `../../../../../../scripts/…` resolves to repo `scripts/` only because the check sits at the stated depth; verified via `pwd -P` (no symlinks).
- Node 26.7.0 identity taken from the path (binary sha matches stated value; version not probed).
- ~32 MiB peak allocation in test 1 — harmless in practice.
